name: customSearchUrl
label: Search URL
help: Sales Navigator search URL copied from /sales/search/people for lead or /sales/search/company for account; must match type.

name: name
label: Name
help: Optional name for the saved search; trimmed, single line, 1–256 characters. A name already used by a saved search of the same type returns savedSearchAlreadyExists. Blank keeps the name Sales Navigator gives it.
